allowed_changes.geometry_only_denominator_cache: Compute and store the exact opportunity denominator for every frozen evaluation edge and segment point once, using the same Gaussian kernel, train-edge weights, prior strength, edge chunk size 32, train chunk size 4096, and summation order as score_chunked_batch pass 1.
allowed_changes.world_batching: Assemble multiple independently generated response worlds as columns and pass them together through the existing exact dense Gaussian projection so every geometry kernel block is reused across columns.
allowed_changes.deterministic_sharding: Partition absolute replicate indices into deterministic contiguous shards. Seed generation must continue to use the frozen absolute replicate index, so changing shard count cannot change any synthetic world.

frozen_execution_constants.batch_width_selection_basis: execution time and memory only after exact numerical equivalence passes

required_validation.cached_vs_original_single_world: statistic and every held-out species score agree within 1e-12
required_validation.batched_vs_sequential_worlds: training strength, statistic, and every held-out species score agree within 1e-12 for each world
required_validation.tie_rich_and_private_shared_cases: include exact ties and both private and shared synthetic residual fields
required_validation.response_firewall: No empirical genetic outcome may be opened during v0.5 development or execution benchmarking

forbidden_changes: using benchmark statistic sign or magnitude to select batch width
qualification_boundary: A v0.5 execution pass can authorize the already-frozen genetic Gate-D computation only. It cannot by itself qualify genetic TTF or authorize empirical genetic interpretation.
